mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1050) and industrial production (INDPRO < 102.5) indicate broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to joint demand-supply weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when both HOUST < 1050 and INDPRO < 102.5 over any 3-year window, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), higher discount rates compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strengthening payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% YoY) signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS > 0.5% YoY over any 3-year window, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1000) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as housing sector slowdowns reduce economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST < 1000 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signal stagflationary pressures that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and UNRATE > 6.0% over any 3-year window, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 105 over any 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.
